record.title: Run acquired-input stock capability control
record.intent: Verify MHO984 identity and enum17 with the acquired-input persisted FlexA seed.
requirements: Execute one frozen stock guest control under loopback confinement with no physical contact.
Require original selected record, identity, bandwidth before and after ParseOption, full catalog and original license consumer evidence.
Require exact retained seed bytes, no installation or regeneration, stock pins and healthy guest policy/state.
Stop and preserve any discrepancy. Seal, commit and push the conclusion before derived execution.
acceptance: The stock control passes or its first failure is recorded.
